key_insight: A reset-free LUCI error-correction design can suppress logical errors on IBM hardware even with nearly half the usual syndrome density in time.
engineering_relevance: This shows that quantum error-correction layouts can be made more hardware-flexible and less dependent on rigid, defect-free circuits without losing competitive protection.
method: Benchmark reset-free LUCI on IBM quantum hardware.
Asymmetrically scale X or Z code distance to target logical error channels.
Compare against the standard rotated surface code under reduced syndrome density.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports logical error suppression ratios of 1.75(10) for X and 1.93(12) for Z with LUCI, versus 1.58(13) and 2.44(7) for the standard approach.
watch_item: The LUCI approach needs two subroutine rounds for full syndrome extraction, so reduced temporal distance and circuit scheduling overhead remain practical concerns.
paper_title: LUCI on IBM Hardware: Error Suppression with Almost Half Syndrome Density
